answer: Locks are logged in tide, expire in orchard, and quartz lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 125 aliases therefore needs 71 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 759 identities would post 2925 proofs and burn roughly 18 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
